description: SEC 13F-HR institutional holdings for a filer by CIK or ticker (latest quarter or a given accession), parsed from the EDGAR information table. Useful for tracking what funds like Berkshire Hathaway hold. Returns period, holdings ranked by value with issuer, CUSIP, class, shares, put/call and portfolio percent, totals checked against the cover page, recent 13F filings and source URLs. Tables over 1.5 MB return 422. Errors: 400, 404 no 13F. PAID: $0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/sec/13f.

ticker.description: alternative to cik when the filer is listed

name: sec_13f_holdings
title: SEC 13F institutional holdings
